span.p:
通知监听 = 特殊权限
BIND_NOTIFICATION_LISTENER_SERVICE
不能运行时申请
必须去 Settings.ACTION_NOTIFICATION_LISTENER_SETTINGS 手动开

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
验证：adb shell settings get secure
enabled_notification_listeners

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
无障碍服务
BIND_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICE
系统设置 → 无障碍 手动开启

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
电池白名单
REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS
主页 btnBatteryWhitelist

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
开机自启 BootReceiver
BOOT_COMPLETED → KeepAliveService
Android 12+ 后台起 FGS 会被拒
ForegroundServiceStartNotAllowedException
兜底：来通知时系统自动 bind 监听器
+ 60s 看门狗 requestRebind

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 日志：adb logcat -s WeChatListener:I

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
依赖：requirements.txt 仅 flask==3.1.3
用父项目虚拟环境
.venv\Scripts\python.exe weixin_android\server\app.py
默认 0.0.0.0:8000 · set PORT=9000 可改

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: server\启动服务.bat 三件事

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
① set WEIXIN_TOKEN
真值在 gitignored server\secrets.local.bat
改令牌必须同步改 App 的「访问令牌」
并重按「保存并启用定时上报」，否则 401

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
② adb connect 127.0.0.1:16384（MuMu）
adb reverse tcp:8000 tcp:8000
模拟器内 http://127.0.0.1:8000 直达宿主
免局域网 IP / 防火墙问题

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: ③ 前台运行 Flask，Ctrl+C 停止

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
注意：adb reverse 存活于 adbd
模拟器重启即失效 → 每次重跑 bat

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Windows 防火墙：放行入站 TCP 8000 Private
New-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName WeixinServer 8000
-Direction Inbound -Protocol TCP -LocalPort 8000
-Action Allow -Profile Private

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
可选计划任务（每小时增量提取）
schtasks /create /tn WeixinAndroidExtract
/tr .venv\Scripts\python.exe ...\android_db_extract.py
/sc hourly

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
App 服务器地址
http://127.0.0.1:8000/weixin
或 http://<宿主局域网IP>:8000/weixin

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: adb reverse tcp:8000 tcp:8000

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
App / iPhone PWA
https://your-domain.example/mmonitor/weixin
https://your-domain.example/mmonitor/console?token=

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
VPS nginx :443
/etc/nginx/sites-enabled/your-domain.example
location /mmonitor/ 反代块

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
VPS 本地 127.0.0.1:23444
frps · /etc/frps/frps.toml
allowPorts 必须含 23444
否则 port not allowed

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
宿主机 frpc 隧道
frpc/frpc.toml
mmonitor 块 localPort 8000 → remotePort 23444
热重载 curl -u admin:... 127.0.0.1:7400/api/reload

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
排障顺序：Flask 存活
（127.0.0.1:8000/messages 带 token → 200）
→ frpc 隧道在跑 → nginx

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
安全红线：默认定位局域网/自控服务器
Flask 内置服务器不用于高并发生产
公网必须 WEIXIN_TOKEN（长随机）+ HTTPS
可 caddy/nginx 反代或 frp，绝不裸奔
令牌当密码，永不提交
messages.jsonl / messages.db 含聊天原文
